meta.title: Session instructions
meta.description: Adds an Instructions field to Settings → General. What you write there is read first, before any work starts, so the deliverables you must not forget travel with every request.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Read first, before any work starts. Write here the deliverables that must not be forgotten — every request begins with them.
instructions.placeholder:
For example:
- Deliver the final report as a PDF in the workspace.
- Do not finish until the tests pass.
- Always update the README.
instructions.saved: Saved. Every request now starts with these instructions.
instructions.empty: Nothing is set, so no instructions are added.
